title: How To License The OpenStack Powered Logo
description: Review the OpenStack Powered logo program, including sponsorship and technical requirements for products running OpenStack software.
body:
Sponsorship Requirements:

This program requires your company to be a Platinum, Gold, Silver, or Associate Member of the OpenInfra Foundation. To become a Member of the OpenInfra Foundation, see openinfra.dev/join/members.

Technical Requirement Summary:

  • A primary purpose of your product must be to run a functioning operational instance of the OpenStack software
  • You must sign a declaration stating your product includes or runs OpenStack software, including the version(s) of the software used
  • You must clearly state which OpenStack projects and release versions are used in the product to set customer expectations, in a way that is conspicuous to customers

Next Steps:

  • Complete the form on the next page indicating your interest in the OpenStack Powered program.
  • The OpenInfra Foundation will reach out with next steps and a copy of the Commercial Use Trademark License after your request is received.
